description:
An easy fun way to play the piano/keyboard in ChatGPT and discuss your performance with the AI!

e.g.

- "@123 Piano I want to play a piano"
- "@123 Piano Give me a piano to play chopsticks"
- "@123 Piano Show me a piano to play a tune I made up"
